verdict.rationale: Docs confirm webhooks can be configured to asynchronously notify of workflow status changes as an alternative to polling, and that webhook payloads are signed (HMAC-SHA256 verification documented). This covers the core story of signed, event-driven notifications instead of polling. Missing for 10: explicit enumeration/documentation of the specific lifecycle event names (created, processing, verified, requires-input) and an example payload showing these states.
